$doc: Vyomi capability registry — API Gateway (v1 REST + v2 HTTP/WebSocket). See s3.json for the contract.

apigateway.rest.resources-methods.title: Resources, methods and integrations (Lambda, HTTP, Mock)
limitations: AWS_IAM and COGNITO_USER_POOLS authorization types are stored and returned but not enforced; only NONE is evaluated on invoke/test.

apigateway.rest.deploy-stages.title: Deploy to a stage; stage variables, throttling, invoke URL
limitations: The invoke URL is well-formed and the stage's deployed integration chain truly executes (via Test), but the host-based execute-api endpoint isn't reachable by DNS from outside Vyomi — use Test or the CLI/SDK against the appliance's own address.

apigateway.rest.cors.title: Enable CORS (console convenience: adds an OPTIONS mock method + headers)

apigateway.account.title: Account settings (CloudWatch role ARN, account-level throttling)

apigateway.usageplans.title: Usage plans (throttle, quota, API-stage and API-key association)

apigateway.client-certificates.title: Client certificates
limitations: The certificate is a real, uniquely-generated PEM-shaped credential stored and returned by the API, but nothing in Vyomi validates it against an actual mTLS handshake.

apigateway.websocket.api.title: WebSocket APIs (routes, integrations, stages)
limitations: $connect/$disconnect/$default routes and Lambda integrations are modeled like HTTP routes; there is no persistent WebSocket connection registry (@connections management API) in Vyomi.

apigateway.custom-domain-names.title: Custom domain names
limitations: The domain resource, its endpoint configuration and API mappings are stored and returned exactly as configured, but no certificate validation or DNS provisioning happens — there is no real ACM/Route 53 behind it.

apigateway.domain-name-access-associatio.title: Domain name access associations (VPC endpoint ↔ private custom domain)

apigateway.vpc-links.title: VPC links (v2)
limitations: VpcLinkStatus always reports AVAILABLE; Vyomi has no real NLB/VPC to actually attach to.

apigateway.agentcore-targets.title: AgentCore targets (MCP access via Bedrock AgentCore)
limitations: Bedrock AgentCore is a separate AWS product Vyomi does not implement at all; declared in the nav for completeness only.

apigateway.developer-portals.title: Developer portals and portal products
limitations: The API Gateway developer portal is a separate hosted product Vyomi does not implement; declared in the nav for completeness only.
